## Project gallery submission

- Project name:
- Registry file: `scan/data/hackathon-projects/<slug>.json`
- Playable HTTPS URL (free practice):
- Source repository and full commit SHA:
- Public team contact / GitHub owner:
- Submission document, demo, AI build log and test evidence:
- Solana mint or explicit pre-launch fixture status:
- What was built for this project versus pre-existing work:
- Known limitations, including real-phone / real-Phantom test status:

## Builder checklist

- [ ] This PR adds/updates only my project's JSON metadata, not the gallery, CI or game code.
- [ ] `node scripts/validate-hackathon-projects.cjs` passes.
- [ ] Links are public and reviewers can play without buying tokens or depositing funds.
- [ ] Access rules, expiry, no early withdrawal, 2% redemption fee and route limitations are disclosed.
- [ ] Asset rights, AI contributions and test limitations are documented; no secrets or private records are included.
- [ ] I understand that owner review, merge and a successful production deployment publish the gallery entry. This does not award a prize or confirm competition eligibility.

## Owner review

Verify submitter ownership (especially updates), play the demo, inspect the pinned source and evidence, confirm disclosures and links, and review the full diff. Do not approve CI or permission changes bundled with an external project entry. Merge only after the required checks pass. Verify the production gallery afterward.
